purpose: Mouse MIRI (myocardial ischaemia-reperfusion) disease input for the Stage 1 MIRI reference DEG list

sources.method: GEO acquisition (GSE108940_RAW.tar: 24 Agilent Feature Extraction GPL7202 FEATURES .txt.gz files) followed by the limma WT IR vs WT Sham DEG analysis; source/GSE108940_WT_deg_results.csv is the limma output written by script/build_deg.R (the raw FEATURES inputs are not redistributed)

local_additions.origin: per-GSE MIRI reference DEG list (mouse-to-human ortholog mapped to the L1000 978 landmark genes); tracked before the restructure
full mouse-to-human L1000 DEG table (human_gene, direction, logFC, P.Value); regenerable, never tracked (global *.csv rule)

notes: MOUSE ORIGIN — corrected 2026-11-13 in issues #176/#182; evidence table in docs/research/stage2-stage3-gene-axis-gse108940-provenance.md. GSE108940 is a mouse (Mus musculus, taxid 10090) MIRI series on GPL7202 (Agilent-014868 Whole Mouse Genome Microarray 4x44K G4122F, Probe Name version), 24 samples: GEO esummary reports taxon Mus musculus / GPL7202 / 24 samples, the series matrix header reports !Series_platform_taxid 10090, and the 24 GSM supplementary files are Agilent GE2-v5 4x44K FEATURES extractions. Row by row, the 28,037 unique Gene strings of source/GSE108940_WT_deg_results.csv are exactly the non-control GeneName values of the platform's FEATURES rows (one FEATURES file yields 28,052 unique non-empty GeneName = 28,037 + 15 control probes; a second file yields the identical set), and their namespaces are mouse-only: 4,463 *Rik, 908 Olfr, 3,561 AK (RIKEN mouse cDNA), 606 ENSMUST, 4,501 GenBank 2-letter+6-digit mouse clone accessions, 505 TC, 105 Gm#, 19 Klra#; there are zero rat Rn# symbols and zero ENSRNO/RGD/rat-UniGene IDs (the 'Rn* 86' candidate evidence was Rnf/Rnase/Rnps/Rnu mouse symbols). The earlier 'Rattus norvegicus / Agilent SurePrint G3 8x60K' label was wrong. The consumed gene set is derived by mouse-to-human ortholog mapping (homologene via script/map_to_human.R:mouse2human, inTax=10090, outTax=9606) and filtered to the human L1000 978 landmarks; the species symbol appears only in the JSON description and the DEG list itself is human-symbol. source/ bytes are unchanged by this correction (sha256 still matches manifest.sha256), so retrieved_at / verified_at / hashed_at are unchanged. The Stage 1 impact is recorded in the research note (the MIRI_up-down union gains TP53 UP; Stage 1 was not edited — a re-run is a separate ticket). The item was split from the old shared `miri/` level under disease_data/ in ticket 05 (spec §4): source/ is the old data/, local/deg/ the old deg/ minus build_deg.R, and both shared R helpers are copied into script/.
